2. The facts of the case, in short, are that respondent Nos.1-6 herein filed Writ Petition No.1745 of 1996 claiming that the order dated 25.01.1996 in L.A. Case No.34 of 1993-94 passed by writ-respondent No.2 is without lawful authority and prayed for a direction upon writ-respondents to release .28k acre land belonging to the petitioner out of plot No.1059 of M.R.R. Khatian No.340 by giving effect to abatement of said L.A. Case No.34 of 1993-94 as per sections 7(4) and 12(1) Of the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982 (the Ordinance, 1982) as amended by Act XX of 1994 which came into effect on 01.12.1994 by publication in the official gazette. The writ-petitioner also prayed for a direction to maintain status-quo. The High Court Division at the first instance on 09.06.1996 issued Rule Nisi and directed the respondents to maintain status-quo in respect of possession of the case land. 

 3. The case of the writ-petitioners was that they are residents in the house with the land of an area of .2834 acre of Mouza Shamsherabad under Police Station-Lakshmipur within Lakshmipur Municipality appertaining to plot No.1059 M.R.R. Khatian No.340 by purchase from its recorded owners through registered Kabala Nos.10230 and 10231 dated 06.05.1984 and Kabala Nos.3788 and 3789 dated 30.03.1991. After purchase they gradually raised the land for construction of residential house, made boundary wall, obtained permission from the Municipality and started construction of the building as per approved plan. Before obtaining permission they applied to writ-respondent No.2 on 06.05.1993 for according 'no objection' for construction of the residential building on the said land and writ-respondent No.3 by his memo No.7-25-93-2052 dated 20.12.1993 gave permission to the writ-petitioners to make construction subject to obtaining sanction from the Municipality. The writ-petitioners were continuing their possession and started construction of the building. In the meantime beyond the knowledge of the writ-petitioners, writ-respondent No.2 started L.A. Case No.34 of 1993-94 on 05.04.1994 in respect of total 1.46 acres land including the land mentioned above under possession of the writ-petitioners for the requirement of writ-respondent No.5 for extension of Lakshmipur Sadar Hospital and subsequently it came to their knowledge that notice under section 3 of the Ordinance, 1982 was served on 17.05.1994 and notice under section 6 was served on the petitioners; vendors, Lalit Mohan Pal and others in whose names records of right were prepared, fixing 09.07.1994 for objection, hearing. 

 9. After hearing the parties, by the impugned judgment and order, the High Court Division made the Rule Nisi absolute declaring that the order dated 25.01.1996 in L.A. Case No.34 of 1993-94 is without lawful authority and directing the respondents to release .284/4 acre, out of plot No.1059 of M.R.R. Khatian No.340 of Mouza Shamsherabad by giving effect to abatement of the said L.A. case.
